audit.skip_reason: backend (localhost:3001) and frontend (localhost:5173) were DOWN at audit time

escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: Attacker-controlled template input executes arbitrary JavaScript via AST type confusion. No auth required.
escalations.remediation: npm update handlebars >=4.7.9; if unused or templating user input, replace with nunjucks or ETA

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Malicious Proto/JSON
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution when parsing untrusted .proto files or crafted JSON payloads. Pulled via OTel stack.

escalations.urgency: LIVE — patch immediately if vitest UI is running
escalations.title: vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution
escalations.description: Any unauthenticated network neighbor can read arbitrary filesystem files and execute code via the vitest UI server (port 51204) when it is running.
escalations.remediation: cd portal/Backend && npm update vitest@latest (>=3.2.6); do NOT run vitest --ui on shared networks; add ACL on port 51204

escalations.title: gRPC (grpc-js) Server Crash — Malformed Message Causes OTel Blackout
escalations.description: Specially crafted gRPC message crashes the server, silencing the observability layer while an attacker operates.

escalations.title: OpenTelemetry Auto-Instrumentations v0.40.0 — Cascading HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs
escalations.description: Package version 0.40.0 transitively pulls multiple vulnerable packages. Prometheus exporter crashes on malformed HTTP, resource detectors may leak env data, sub-packages have unpatched HIGH CVEs. 577 transitive deps is above supply-chain risk threshold.
escalations.remediation: npm update @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node >=0.79.0; audit full @opentelemetry stack; restrict /metrics to authorized networks

escalations.title: form-data CRLF Injection — HTTP Header Injection via Multipart Field Names
escalations.description: Multipart field names and filenames not escaped for CRLF. Attacker-supplied filenames can inject arbitrary HTTP headers.
escalations.remediation: npm update form-data >=4.0.6; sanitise all file upload filenames

escalations.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — Crafted URLs Hang Express Router
escalations.description: Exponential regex backtracking on routes with multiple parameters. Attacker crafts URL matching pattern to hang the express router.
escalations.remediation: npm update express >=4.18.3 in Source/Backend and Portal/Backend

escalations.title: esbuild Dev-Server CORS Bypass — Source Map / Asset Exfiltration
escalations.description: esbuild dev server does not properly enforce CORS. Any website can read dev server responses including source maps and transpiled code.
escalations.remediation: npm update vite >=5.0 (pulls safe esbuild); add --host 127.0.0.1 to dev server scripts

backlog.title: GET /api/search not wired into app.ts — 5 CI tests fail on every run
backlog.description: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search?q= cross-entity typeahead search. Route not registered in app.ts. All 5 tests return 404 and fail on every CI run.
backlog.recommendation: Register /api/search route in app.ts; implement handler in Source/Backend/src/routes/

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer excludes portal/ and platform/ — false-green CI gates
backlog.description: source_dirs = ['Source', 'E2E'] hardcoded. portal/ (1073 Verifies comments, FR-001–095) and platform/orchestrator/ (FR-TMP-001–010) are completely unscanned. Gate reports 34 MISSING for dev-workflow-platform even though all are implemented in portal/.
backlog.recommendation: Extend source_dirs to include portal/ and platform/orchestrator/; drive from inspector.config.yml source.dirs

backlog.title: Route handlers call store.* directly — service layer bypassed in 3 files (14+ call sites)
backlog.description: CLAUDE.md mandates: no direct DB calls from route handlers. workItems.ts (5 call sites), workflow.ts (8 call sites), intake.ts (2 call sites) all call store.* directly. Correct pattern shown in assessment.ts, router.ts, changeHistory.ts.
backlog.recommendation: Extract store interactions into service functions in Source/Backend/src/services/; delegate from route handlers

backlog.title: FR-TMP-001..010 (Tiered Merge Pipeline) outside enforcer scope; FR-TMP-005/006 unconfirmed
backlog.description: 10 requirements in Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md are implemented in platform/orchestrator/ but never scanned by the enforcer. FR-TMP-005 (AI PR Review) and FR-TMP-006 (Auto-Merge Logic) lack confirmed Verifies: comments.
backlog.recommendation: Fix covered by QO-002; additionally spot-verify FR-TMP-005/006 Verifies: comments in platform/orchestrator/

backlog.title: brace-expansion DoS — 3 separate vectors (hang, quadratic CPU, OOM)
backlog.description: Three DoS vectors: zero-step sequences hang process, consecutive empty braces cause quadratic CPU, large expansions cause OOM.
backlog.recommendation: npm update minimatch >=5.1.0 or glob >=11; do not use brace-expansion to parse untrusted glob patterns

backlog.title: js-yaml YAML merge-key DoS — O(n²) CPU on crafted YAML input
backlog.description: YAML parser enters quadratic time on chained merge keys. Attacker-supplied YAML config can stall the parser.
backlog.recommendation: npm update js-yaml >=3.15.0; add timeout on YAML parsing if untrusted input is parsed

backlog.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped </style> tags in CSS output
backlog.description: PostCSS does not escape </style> in CSS output. Injected CSS with </style> can close style tag and inject arbitrary HTML/JS.
backlog.recommendation: npm update postcss >=8.5.10; sanitise dynamically generated CSS input

backlog.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram absent from Source/Backend metrics
backlog.description: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 metrics. Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts implements 3 counters but no histogram. Histogram correctly present in portal/Backend/src/metrics.ts. Verifies comment is incorrect.
backlog.recommendation: Add Histogram to Source/Backend/src/metrics.ts or narrow Verifies comment to the 3 counters actually implemented

backlog.title: Logger always emits JSON — no NODE_ENV check for dev pretty-printing
backlog.description: CLAUDE.md and FR-003 require pretty-printing in development. process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(entry)) is unconditional — no NODE_ENV branch. Local development requires piping through jq.
backlog.recommendation: Add process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' branch using JSON.stringify(entry, null, 2) or formatted output

backlog.title: Two logger files with incompatible call signatures — object-first calls silently corrupt message
backlog.description: Both export a logger with different signatures. Object-first calls to utils/logger.ts produce '[object Object]' as message. Routes import from both paths.
backlog.recommendation: Canonicalize on one file; update all import sites to use one path; ensure both call signatures are supported by the chosen canonical file

backlog.title: body-parser DoS — invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement
backlog.description: Invalid limit value silently disables size enforcement, allowing unbounded payloads to consume memory.
backlog.recommendation: npm update express (should pull safe body-parser); set explicit limit parameter in body-parser config

backlog.title: @babel/core arbitrary file read via source-map URL comments (build-time only)
backlog.description: Source map URL comments can trigger arbitrary file read. Exploitable only if attacker can modify source files at build time.

backlog.title: Vitest/Vite major version lags — vitest@1.2.2 vs 4.x current
backlog.description: Vitest is 2 major versions behind latest. Multiple security and stability fixes between 1.x and 4.x. Vite is below latest path-traversal fix in optimized deps .map handling.
backlog.recommendation: Plan vitest 1.x → 4.x migration; npm update vite >=8.1.5 in frontends

backlog.title: eslint-disable comments without documented justification
backlog.description: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed with no explanation. Cannot distinguish intentional from noise-silencing.
backlog.recommendation: Add one-line comment explaining intentional omission, e.g. '// intentionally omit X to avoid infinite loop on initial mount'

cross_references.impact: Closes 3 P1 findings and multiple embedded HIGH CVEs

cross_references.single_fix: Extend source_dirs in tools/traceability-enforcer.py to include portal/ and platform/orchestrator/
cross_references.impact: Closes 2 P2 findings; fixes false-green gate for 2/3 of codebase

cross_references.single_fix: npm update express >=4.18.3 in Source/Backend and Portal/Backend
npm update vite in Source/Frontend and Portal/Frontend; add --host 127.0.0.1 to dev scripts
